lines.text: Excuse me — do you have a moment? I couldn't help but notice something strange when I rode in.
Oh? A traveler. Welcome to the village. What's on your mind?
There's a mana fluctuation coming from somewhere nearby. Faint, but irregular. Do you know what might be causing it?
Ah, that. You must mean the northern side of the mountain. Part of the village extends out that way — open terrain, no walls. Monsters have been spotted there, off and on.
Monsters. And that doesn't worry anyone around here?
Not really, no. We have the Dawncore watching over us. It's kept this village safe for as long as anyone can remember. Nothing's gotten through — not once.
I don't doubt it's been reliable. But the mana I'm picking up isn't steady. It's fluctuating — spiking, then dropping. That's not normal background noise.
Hmm. I'll be honest — most people here can't sense mana at all. If something really is off, I wouldn't know how to tell.
Which is exactly what concerns me.

Well, if your gut's telling you something's wrong, maybe go have a look yourself. Curiosity's not a bad thing. Oh — and you won't have to trek all the way on foot. There's a waypoint portal just a little ways from here. It'll take you right to that part of the mountain.
...Alright. I'll check it out. I'd rather be wrong and come back looking foolish than ignore this and regret it later.
Stay safe out there. And hey — feel free to come back and tell me what you find.
